All the BDs are quite poor, the JPN/TWN/HKG/USA (GKIDS) BD has a lot of badly debanded scenes with grain spammed everywhere harming detail, the ITA BD does the same but on steroids, the GBR/GER/USA (Funimation) BD has tons of banding everywhere, the FRA BD is also the same but on steroids plus gamma bugged and wrong matrix. What about the fabled RUS BD? It looks to just be a re-encode of the GBR BD for the intro sequence and a re-encode of the JPN BD for the rest of the movie, presumably to remove the hardsubs present in the intro
The 4K JPN BD has none of these issues and much better compression. The catch? The terrible upscale destroys the lineart. Unlucker
